decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with its own webpage and clear fit with the firm's engineered drainage system portfolio, management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course after only one year.
A floor-level shower drainage system is highly central to the firm's stated move toward integrated and low-profile bathroom solutions, so early commitment is likely to be sustained.
Its dedicated page and strong alignment with the firm's design-conscious positioning make management especially likely to justify and maintain this launch.
Because an integrated-slope shower element closely supports renovation-friendly installation solutions, the firm is likely to keep it on the market and attribute any early weakness to adoption time.

The explicit launch communication and separate web presentation signal visible commitment, which under escalation logic makes withdrawal within a year unlikely despite it being somewhat less central than shower-focused products.

This product appears less prominently and is somewhat more peripheral to the firm's core bathroom drainage direction, but as a fresh launch management would still more likely retain it than admit failure so soon.
